STEP 1: SET UP YOUR SIGN-IN

You'll use one account, Afiax IAM, for everything at Oortcloud. Set a password and a security key (an authenticator app, a passkey or a security key): Oortcloud requires both for every staff member.
The link works once, for a few days:
https://iam.afiax.africa/ui/login/user/invite?userID=1&code=EXAMPLE

STEP 2: WHERE YOU'LL WORK

The Oortcloud Console: customers, tenants, people and your team's work
  https://console.afiax.africa/console
Oortcloud Virtual Office: chat, channels and calls with the team
  https://office.chat.afiax.africa
The Oortcloud Academy: your courses and the Oortcloud Handbook
  https://academy.afiax.africa/lms

Each one asks you to sign in with Afiax IAM: use wanjiru@oortcloudcomputing.co.ke and the password and security key from step 1.

STEP 3: YOUR REQUIRED TRAINING

  Oortcloud Handbook, due 15 Dec 2026
  https://academy.afiax.africa/lms/courses/oortcloud-handbook
  Health Data Privacy and Security, due 31 Dec 2026
  https://academy.afiax.africa/lms/courses/health-data-privacy

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

Grace Achieng will take you through your first tasks. What you can see in each system follows your role; if something you need is missing, ask them.
